facts.fact: According to the page, businesses with complete Google Business Profiles get 7x more clicks than incomplete ones.
facts.quote: Businesses with complete profiles get 7x more clicks than incomplete ones.

facts.fact: The page states that 88% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.
facts.quote: 88% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.

facts.fact: The page says that budgeting about $100-200 covers 1,000 quality flyers or door hangers plus distribution.
facts.quote: Budget about $100-200 for 1,000 quality pieces plus distribution.

facts.fact: The page states that Google Local Service Ads average $15-50 per lead depending on industry.
facts.quote: Average cost: $15-50 per lead depending on industry.

facts.fact: The page suggests starting Facebook and Instagram local ads with a small daily budget of $10-20.
facts.quote: Start with a small daily budget ($10-20)

facts.fact: The page states that local newspaper ads cost $50-200 per ad.
The page states that neighborhood magazine ads cost $100-500 per ad.
Adwave, the vendor, states that its streaming TV local targeting platform starts at $30 a day.
Adwave, the vendor, claims that 94% of its streaming ads are watched to completion.
facts.quote: 94% of streaming ads are watched to completion

facts.fact: Adwave, the vendor, claims commercials can run on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ other premium channels with geographic targeting.
facts.quote: You can now run commercials on NBC, Hulu, ESPN, and 100+ other premium channels

facts.fact: The page gives a typical trade area for a restaurant as a 5-10 minute drive for casual dining, with destination spots drawing from farther away.
facts.quote: 5-10 minute drive for casual dining, farther for destination spots

facts.fact: The page states that a retail store's typical trade area is a 15-20 minute radius.
The page describes Google Business Profile as a free tool.
facts.quote: This free tool should be a top priority for any business serving local customers.

facts.fact: The page defines customer acquisition cost as marketing spend divided by new customers.
facts.quote: Marketing spend divided by new customers

facts.fact: The page states that local businesses can run TV advertising on the same channels as national brands, targeting only households in their area.
facts.quote: You can put your local business on the same channels they use, targeting just the households in your area.
